quote: whether or not a relatively prime pair of amicable numbers exists is still an open question
note: Explicit formulation as an open problem in 'On Relatively Prime Odd Amicable Numbers', Mathematics of Computation, Volume 23, Issue 107, pages 539-543 (September 1969). While the question may have been discussed earlier, this is the earliest documented explicit scholarly formulation.
